findings.title: Rewrite the losing-answer task instruction
findings.body: e04s02 task 4 tells the implementer to linearize the admission race "without losing optimistic answers." PLAN.md line 55, SC-e04s02-P0-04, and the test plan require the opposite: the losing submission is rejected and must not appear as accepted history. A worker following the task sentence can retain the losing answer even though the scenario forbids it. Change the task text to retain selected/submitted/failed/unknown evidence and exclude losing optimistic answers from history.

findings.title: Point native regressions at pty_control
findings.body: e04s03 task 4 runs cargo test --test native, and task 6 plus PLAN.md line 56 run cargo test --test pty_control --test native. tests/ has no native binary; native cases are the pty_control module via tests/pty_control.rs line 16 path pty_control/native.rs. Cargo --test selects integration binaries, so both commands fail before the ownership regressions run. Use cargo test --test pty_control native, or an equivalent filter inside that existing binary.
